name: ai-project-management-platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start -w api" "npm run dev -w web"

scripts.check:rc: npm run check && npm run test:rc-e2e
